sections.heading: API design and blast radius management

items.title: Netflix Builds Quasar to Measure the Blast Radius of Library API Changes
items.blurb: Netflix developed Quasar, an internal tool that combines semantic code indexing and API comparisons to identify downstream consumers affected by library changes.

items.title: Presentation: From Fan-Out to Fast: Sub-100ms API Design in Distributed Systems
items.blurb: Saranya Vedagiri explains how to design resilient, low-latency distributed APIs under 100ms.

items.title: Article: Engineering Reliable Telematics from Smartphone Sensors
items.blurb: Smartphones make telematics more accessible by combining location, motion sensors, computing power, and connectivity in a single device.
